return static function (string $type, array $input): ?string {

    $type = $bundle['php_classes'][$type] ?? $type;
    $number = static function ($value): ?string {
        if (is_int($value)) { return (string) $value; }
        if (is_float($value) && is_finite($value) && floor($value) === $value && abs($value) <= 9007199254740991) { return sprintf('%.0f', $value); }
        if (is_string($value) && preg_match('/^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/D', $value)) { return $value === '-0' ? '0' : $value; }
        return null;
    };
    $visit = static function (string $message, $data, string $path, int $depth) use (&$visit, $bundle, $number): ?string {
        if ($depth > 128) { return '参数嵌套过深'; }
        if (!is_array($data)) { return $path . ' 必须是对象'; }
        foreach ($bundle['messages'][$message] ?? [] as $name => $rule) {
            $field = $path === '' ? $name : $path . '.' . $name;
            if (!array_key_exists($name, $data)) {
                if (!$rule['optional']) { return $field . ' 不能为空'; }
                continue;
            }
            $value = $data[$name];
            if ($value === null) { if ($rule['nullable']) { continue; } return $field . ' 不允许 null'; }
            if ($rule['collection'] !== 'one') {
                if (!is_array($value)) { return $field . ' 集合类型无效'; }
                $values = $value;
            } else { $values = [$value]; }
            foreach ($values as $index => $value) {
                if ($value === null && $rule['collection'] !== 'one' && ($rule['item_nullable'] ?? false)) { continue; }
                $position = $rule['collection'] === 'one' ? $field : $field . '[' . $index . ']';
                if ($rule['kind'] === 'message') {
                    $error = $visit($rule['message'], $value, $position, $depth + 1);
                    if ($error !== null) { return $error; }
                } elseif ($rule['kind'] === 'number') {
                    $canonical = $number($value);
                    if ($canonical === null || !in_array($canonical, $rule['values'], true)) { return $position . ' 必须是指定枚举的数字值'; }
                } elseif (!in_array($value, $rule['values'], true)) { return $position . ' 必须是指定枚举的 field_name 或允许值'; }
            }
        }
        return null;
    };
    $error = $visit($type, $input, '', 0);
    if ($error !== null) { return $error; }
    if (isset($bundle['operations'][$type])) {
        $operation = $bundle['operations'][$type];
        $key = $operation['discriminator'];
        if (!array_key_exists($key, $input) && $operation['optional']) { return null; }
        $branch = $input[$key] ?? null;
        if (!is_string($branch) || !isset($operation['branches'][$branch])) { return $key . ' 操作类型无效'; }
